title: Waitlist
summary: A sheet for people without an invite. It explains that Bipe opens slowly and puts an e-mail address on the waitlist.

phase.description: sending: POST /v1/waitlist runs. done: the server answered 202. failed: a network error or 429.

emailInvalid.description: true after submit when the address is not plausible. Shows bipe_signup_email_invalid.

join.effect: Checks the address locally, then sends POST /v1/waitlist with source app and lang (pt or en from the system language). On 202 sets phase to done.

close.effect: Closes the sheet and goes back to signup-invite-code.

notes: The server always answers 202 for a well-formed address, also when the address is already on the list. The screen shows done in both cases.
Local e-mail check: BipeHandle.isPlausibleEmail (iOS), BipeSignupRules.isPlausibleEmail (Android). Bipe logic: BipeAPIClient.joinWaitlist (iOS), BipeApiClient.joinWaitlist (Android).
product/data.json already lists the waitlist address; this screen adds no new personal data.
